description: Passive subdomain enumeration for a domain from live certificate transparency logs: certspotter (unexpired certificates) with crt.sh as fallback or for expired history. Returns deduplicated hostnames with first seen and last seen issuance dates, certificate count, issuers and whether a wildcard certificate covers the name, plus the list of wildcard entries. Set resolve=true to also check the first 40 names with DNS over HTTPS and mark live hosts. Passive lookup of public certificate transparency logs; nothing is sent to the target. Use it on assets you own or are authorised to test.

domain.description: Registered domain, for example "example.com". A URL is accepted and reduced to its host.

include_expired.description: Also include names from expired certificates (uses crt.sh). Finds retired hosts; slower.

limit.description: Max hostnames returned (1-1000). Totals are always reported.

max_pages.description: certspotter pages to read (1-5). Each page is one request against its keyless rate limit.

resolve.description: Also resolve up to 40 of the returned names over DNS (newest first).

source.description: auto = certspotter first (fast, unexpired certificates), crt.sh if it fails or throttles. crtsh = crt.sh only (includes expired with include_expired).

name: find_subdomains
title: Find subdomains (certificate transparency)
